inputs.name: DesktopRunService.constructor.session
inputs.description: The ProjectSessionService of this client: start reads its root and busy flag, claims the repository through its arbiter, and sets busy while a run holds it. The instance is stored by reference, not copied.

inputs.name: DesktopRunService.constructor.providers
inputs.description: The ProviderDiscoveryService that the prepare steps use to select each run's runner and, for a plan of a pages, layouts or components entity, to list providers for image generation. This file stores it and never calls its methods itself.

inputs.name: DesktopRunService.constructor.emit
inputs.description: The callback that this client's runs send events to: execute first emits a 'status' event with phase 'queued', then a 'finished', 'cancelled' or 'failed' event when the run ends.

inputs.name: DesktopRunService.start.request
inputs.description: The request to start: a RunRequest (no intent) for a change or plan of an existing entity, a ProjectRunRequest with intent 'create' for a new plan, or a ProjectTaskRequest with intent 'task'. designCount checks designOptions first, so an invalid count is refused before the run is claimed.

examples.text: Add a loading state to the evidence grid.
A component that lists the recorded verification runs of one unit.
Explain how the evidence grid chooses its columns.

inputs.name: DesktopRunService.cancel.runId
inputs.description: The run id that start returned, a random UUID; cancel aborts only when it equals the id of the active run. Any other value, including the id of a run that has already ended, returns false and aborts nothing.

outputs.name: DesktopRunService.start
outputs.description: The resolved value of start: the new run's id, returned once preparation has succeeded. Execution starts on a later timer tick, and rejections are described under errors.

outputs.name: DesktopRunService.cancelActive
outputs.description: Nothing is returned: it aborts the active run's controller, whether the run is still being prepared or is executing, and does nothing when no run is active.

outputs.name: DesktopRunService.cancel
outputs.description: True when runId matched the active run and its controller was aborted, false otherwise. True means the abort was requested, not that the run has already stopped.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Thrown by start with 'A run is already active in this project.' when the session is busy or the arbiter cannot hold the project root for this client, since the arbiter allows one run per repository across every client on this computer. No run starts, and the session's busy flag is left as it was.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Thrown by start with 'An agent or planning write is active in another Harness app.' when the project root is set but no repository lease is obtained; the run is released before the error is rethrown.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Thrown by designCount with 'A Change makes no design options.'; start rejects with it before any state is set, when designOptions is given on a request whose mode is not 'plan'.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Thrown by designCount with 'Design options must be a whole number from 1 to 10.'; start rejects with it before any state is set, when the designOptions of a plan is not an integer from 1 to 10.

errors.name: RunCancelled
errors.description: Thrown by the prepare step when the run is aborted while it is being prepared, by cancelActive or by a lost repository lease; start rejects with it after the run is released.

errors.name: Run preparation error
errors.description: Any other error from designCount, the arbiter claim, the repository lease or run preparation reaches the caller unchanged, so its name is set by the code that threw it.
